note: These tools are registered by assets/webmcp.js inside a page open in a WebMCP-capable browser. This site is NOT an MCP JSON-RPC server: there is no MCP transport endpoint to connect an MCP client to.

tools.name: request_coffee_service_assessment
tools.title: On-page quote request form
tools.description: The on-page quote request form (declarative WebMCP tool on the lead form of every page). Requests a custom assessment or quote for a business location in Kyiv or Kyiv Oblast. Automatic submit is off: the visitor reviews the fields and presses the button.

tools.name: get_anima_service_info
tools.title: Anima Volitiva service facts
tools.description: Answer a buyer's question about Anima Volitiva's B2B coffee machine rental and service (equipment brands, packages, trial, support/SLA, coverage area, company history, client count, contacts/hours) using only facts already published on this site. Anything not published on the site is reported as not published, never invented.

question.description: The visitor's question about Anima's coffee machine rental/service, in their own words.

local_search.description: Use an already-installed on-device model to suggest a cited public passage when keyword lookup misses. Defaults to false.

tools.name: get_anima_products
tools.title: Anima Volitiva published lineup
tools.description: Return the lineup Anima publishes: machine brands per type (super-automatic, professional espresso), premium roasted coffee, the Start/Pro/Max packages (custom quote, prices not published), the free 14-day trial with no prepayment, the service area, and how to request a quote. Optional category filter. Read-only; returns only published items.

category.description: Optional: limit to one product category.

tools.name: prepare_coffee_quote_request
tools.title: Prefill the coffee service quote request
tools.description: Prefill the on-page quote request form (name, business, city, machines, contact, message) from details the visitor gave you, scroll to it and focus it. It NEVER submits: the visitor reviews the fields and presses 'Get my custom assessment' themselves. Only pass details the visitor actually provided.

city.description: City. Service area is Kyiv city and Kyiv Oblast.

machines.description: Number of coffee machines needed, if known.

contact.description: Email or phone number to reach the visitor.

message.description: Optional notes for the Anima team.

tools.name: check_service_area
tools.title: Check whether Anima serves a city
tools.description: Check whether a city is inside Anima Volitiva's published service area (Kyiv city and Kyiv Oblast). Read-only. Use it BEFORE preparing a quote or trial request. If the city is not covered by a published claim the answer is published:false and the visitor should name the city in the request.

city.description: City or town of the venue.

tools.name: get_chrome_builtin_ai_status
tools.title: Chrome built-in AI availability
tools.description: Report whether this browser exposes Chrome's on-device AI (Prompt API and Summarizer API): each is one of available, downloadable, downloading, unavailable or unsupported. Read-only availability check: nothing is downloaded, no prompt is sent and no data leaves the device.

tools.name: prepare_free_trial_request
tools.title: Prefill a free 14-day trial request
tools.description: Prefill the on-page request form for the free 14-day trial (no prepayment) from details the visitor gave you, adding venue type, timeline and package interest to the message so the sales team can qualify the lead. It NEVER submits: the visitor reviews the fields and presses the button.

city.description: City. Service area is Kyiv city and Kyiv Oblast.

machines.description: Number of coffee machines needed, if known.

contact.description: Email or phone number to reach the visitor.

timeline.description: When the visitor wants to start.

package_interest.description: Package the visitor leans towards, if any (contents and prices are not published).

message.description: Optional notes for the Anima team.
